header.running_head: Condemning Rulers who Live Lives Above the Standards of the Common People and who Veil Themselves from people in Need

blocks.text:
(RA) said, "O Yarfa! Come with me to Amr bin Al Aas (RA). You will see that he has story-tellers with him, lanterns will be burning and rugs of velvet will be spread out, which have been taken from the booty belonging to the Muslims. You will greet him and he will reply, after which you will ask permission to enter and he will not grant permission until he enquires who you are."
The two men proceeded until they reached the door of Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) greeted by saying, "As Salaamu Alaykum!" to which Hadhrat Amr (RA) replied, "Wa Alaykumus Salaam." When Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked whether he could enter, Hadhrat Amr (RA) first asked, "Who are you?" To this Yarfa replied, "This is the one who is about to spoil your fun. This is the Ameerul Mu'mineen." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then opened the door and found story-tellers there, lanterns burning and rugs of velvet. Hadhrat Umar (RA) urgently instructed Yarfa to shut the door and struck Hadhrat Amr (RA) with his whip right between the ears. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then folded up all the goods and placed it at the centre of the room. He then issued the command that no one should move until he returned.
After leaving Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "O Yarfa! Let us go to Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA). You will see that he has story-tellers with him, lanterns will be burning and rugs of wool will be spread out, which have been taken from the booty belonging to the Muslims. You will greet him and he will reply, after which you will ask permission to enter and he will not grant permission until he enquires who you are."
The two men proceeded until they reached the door of Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) greeted by saying, "As Salaamu Alaykum!" to which Hadhrat Abu Moosa (RA) replied, "Wa Alaykumus Salaam." When Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked whether he could enter, Hadhrat Abu Moosa (RA) first asked, "Who are you?" To this Yarfa replied, "This is the one who is about to spoil your fun. This is the Ameerul Mu'mineen." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then opened the door and found story-tellers there, lanterns burning and rugs of wool spread out. Hadhrat Umar (RA) struck Hadhrat Abu Moosa (RA) with his whip right between the ears and then said, "You too, O Abu Moosa (have you also changed since leaving Madinah)?" Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! This is what I have (which is less than the others) You have already seen what my companions are doing whereas I had also received what they have received (but have not gone to the extent they have)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Then what is all this about?" Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) replied, "The people of the city believe that this is the only way by which to rule." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then folded up all the goods and placed it at the centre of the room. He then issued the command that no one should move until he returned.
